description: Which airports serve a city or town, or what is the code of an airport by name? Returns matching airports (scheduled-service and larger first) with IATA/ICAO codes, city, region, country and coordinates. For a town (34,000 towns over 15k people) with no scheduled-service airport of its own, also returns the nearest airports that have scheduled flights, with distances. Use "City, Country" or the country argument to disambiguate (e.g. "Cambridge, NZ" vs "Cambridge, GB").

country.description: Optional. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or English country name.

query.description: City, town or airport name, e.g. "Auckland", "Cambridge, New Zealand", "Heathrow".

name: find_airports
title: Find airports serving a city or matching a name
